faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we hear the most.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: Open your profile settings and use the security section to set a new password. If you forgot the current one, use the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page and follow the email instructions.

inviteTeam.question: How do I invite team members?
inviteTeam.answer: Go to Account Settings → Team members → Invite member. Enter their email, choose a role (admin, manager, staff or viewer), and we will email them an invitation link.

importPayments.question: Can I bulk import payments?
importPayments.answer: Yes. In Payment Tracking, click Bulk Import and upload a CSV file. We provide a downloadable template with the required columns.

changePlan.question: How do I change my subscription plan?
changePlan.answer: Open Account Settings → Subscription, choose a billing cycle, and pick the plan that fits your portfolio. Upgrades take effect immediately, downgrades at the next renewal.

exportData.question: Can I export my data?
exportData.answer: All tables and reports in CondoAI can be exported as CSV or PDF using the Export button in the page toolbar. You can also generate custom reports in Reports & Analytics.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: CondoAI is fully available in English and Portuguese. You can change your language at any time from your profile preferences.
